texts: Overall infection rates with mechanical circulatory support are about 30 percent: D.
Most are infections of the driveline where it leaves the skin, the broccoli at the cable's exit; pump-pocket infections and bloodstream infections are less common but more serious.
Long-term suppressive antibiotics are not routinely necessary, the unused pencil; good driveline care prevents most infections.
Bleeding, not thromboembolism, is the commonest complication, and most patients need transfusion, the red doughnuts; organ failure after implantation is not rare.
Memory hook: three cables in ten sprout broccoli.
